label: early original-phase input of h/u/v/e/n/i/x (positions 1-3)
explanation: Reset-gate neuron active almost only in the original (input) phase at early positions: never at t=0, peak at t=1-2 (81% of mass), weaker at t=3, fading by t=5; essentially silent in the copy phase, with small weak activations at the delimiter. Within those positions it is token-selective: h is strongest (top activations are h at position 2-3, especially after k-initial sequences), then u, v, e, n, i, x; f/0/b weaker; j and most other letters rarely. Mostly first occurrences of the token. Some spillover onto the step right after a strongly active h/i. Predicate (early position AND preferred token) gets dev F1 0.66, mass recall 0.82; misses are graded weaker tokens and spillover steps; false positives are preferred tokens in contexts where it stays below threshold.
